item.title: Abandoned Vehicle, 22nd August
item.description:
Vehicle (GM14 YEU - Silver Ford Fiesta) has been left in the same place for OVER two months without being moved it has flat tyres and damage and appears to be leaking fluid. The street it’s on is extremely busy due to the location being close to Sidcup station so is used daily by commuters, its an unofficial car park for Marlowe House staff & Longlands primary school staff & parents. It has also gathered the attention of local kids who have tried damaging it further. Its very inconveniently parked, an eyesore and we fear it will be targeted to be futher vandalised.
